hook.head: Your prompts are too short.
hook.vo: Your prompts are too short. Here's how to fix them.

tips.vo: Tell Claude who it's for, and why. A website for a Jeddah bakery that takes orders on WhatsApp gets a much better result than: make me a website.
tips.head: Say who it's for.

tips.vo: Paste one example of what good looks like. One example teaches Claude your style faster than a whole paragraph of rules.
tips.head: Show an example.

msgs: "Fresh out the oven. Gone by noon."

tips.vo: End your prompt with the exact format you want. Three bullet points. One table. Under fifty words. Claude follows it.
tips.head: Say the format.

lines: 2. Baked at dawn, gone by noon.

cta.head: Save this for later.
cta.vo: Save this for later... and follow Pixel and Co, for more.
